QUOTE: "A missing optional grammar makes the route resolve to nothing instead of raising." and "The build-time not-indexed report ... names the file types that were in scope but not read."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that missing grammars degrade instead of failing, with routing gated by a capability check (`_grammar_available` / `has_language`) and unread file types reported as not indexed.
